description.en: A self-contained agent preset for biomedical research: 63 workflow skills, 51 public-data MCP tools, and a per-session subagent cap.
description.zh: 面向生物医学研究的自包含 agent 预设：63 个流程技能、51 个公开数据源 MCP 工具、3 个子智能体并发闸。

description.en: Biomedical research collaborator preset: bulk/single-cell omics, variant and clinical annotation, structure prediction and docking, literature evidence grading, survival statistics, publication figures and manuscripts. Ships its own MCP server (51 tools over PubMed/Ensembl/PDB/AlphaFold/ClinVar/gnomAD/GTEx/GEO/PRIDE/cBioPortal/CIViC/ENCODE/JASPAR/Rfam/ChEMBL/PubChem/Open Targets/openFDA/OpenAlex/arXiv) and 63 skills, so it carries no dependency on external plugin directories.
description.zh: 生物医学研究合作者预设：bulk/单细胞组学、变异与临床注释、结构预测与分子对接、文献证据分级、生存统计、投稿级图表与稿件。自带 MCP 服务（51 个工具，覆盖 PubMed/Ensembl/PDB/AlphaFold/ClinVar/gnomAD/GTEx/GEO/PRIDE/cBioPortal/CIViC/ENCODE/JASPAR/Rfam/ChEMBL/PubChem/Open Targets/openFDA/OpenAlex/arXiv）与 63 个技能，不依赖任何外部插件目录。
